uutiset.t: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 23
uutiset.s: Oil declined as traders weighed signs of robust crude exports against the prospect of escalating hostilities in the Middle East.

uutiset.t: Stock Traders Brace For More Volatility After Tech-Driven Rout
uutiset.s: Wall Street enters the new trading week under intense pressure after a violent rotation out of US stocks left investors wondering if more pain is in store.

uutiset.t: World's Biggest Warrants Market Is Fueled by Unusual Trading in Hong Kong
uutiset.s: The $577 billion Hong Kong market has tell-tale signs of artificially inflated trading, insiders say.

uutiset.t: Gold Deluge Keeps China’s $1 Trillion Trade Surplus in Check
uutiset.s: China’s gold imports surged to a record $209 billion so far this year, in an unprecedented buying spree that followed a promise by top officials to make their country into the world’s marketplace instead of just its factory.

uutiset.t: Live: Asia-Pacific Stocks, Currencies React After Nasdaq, S&P 500 Selloff
US Stock Futures Open Higher After Tech Selloff: Markets Wrap
uutiset.s: US equity-index futures opened higher in early Asian trading as buyers returned following Friday’s sharp selloff sparked by an unwinding of the artificial intelligence trade. Treasury bond futures fell.

uutiset.t: Aussie Seen Rebounding Against Kiwi From Worst Month Since 2022
uutiset.s: Australia’s dollar is poised to rebound against its New Zealand counterpart after sliding toward its steepest monthly drop in four years as sticky inflation challenges bets on domestic interest-rate cuts, analysts say.

uutiset.t: Dip Buyers Hesitate to Step In as Nasdaq 100 Nears a Bear Market
uutiset.s: Since the fundamental outlook did not change dramatically during last week’s massive selloff in stocks and many valuation measures are now screaming bargain, contrarian impulses to buy the dip are running strong.

uutiset.t: Bond Market’s Go-To Trade for Fed Hikes Roiled by Stocks Retreat
uutiset.s: Wall Street is coalescing around one of the bond market’s favorite ways to bet that the Federal Reserve will press ahead with its vow to tame inflation, even as slumping stocks darken the economic outlook.

uutiset.t: Goldman Traders See Entry Point in US Stocks But Warn of Risks
uutiset.s: Goldman Sachs Group Inc.’s trading desk says last week’s selloff has created an attractive opportunity to snap up US stocks. Still, the bank cautions that overall investor positioning remains elevated, signaling the broader capitulation needed for a meaningful rally could be missing.
